acf.speaker_position: Co-Founder / CSO #1 End-to-End Insurance Factory NEODIGITAL VERSICHERUNG AG & CEO Neodigital Autoversicherung AG
acf.desc_episodes:
Stephen Voss is a Sales & Marketing expert with over 25 years of experience in the banking & insurance industries. He has held senior positions with Zurich, AIG, Hartford Life , the Halifax Bank of Scotland (now Lloyds TSB), and Deutsche Bank, where he gained a wealth of experience.
Since Jan 2017 Stephen is founder, investor and CEO of the newly listed NEODIGITAL AG, a full digital venture to explore the possibilities of a fully process orientated digital insurance service.
